verdicts.reason: Both invert the hierarchy: the quote, which carries the message, has shrunk to small body text while the 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' attribution is bigger and bolder than it. Both also center the logo over nothing, so it doesn't line up with the left text column, and the oversized can dominates the frame. A keeps a ~30px left margin; in B the quote mark and text are jammed about 18px from the left edge and the attribution is slightly heavier still, so A is marginally less bad.
